newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia, World Bank discuss further aid - radio.
newsitem.headline: Croatia, World Bank discuss further aid - radio.

text.p: Croatian and World Bank officials discussed further aid for overhauling the country's financial sector, pension system and for rebuilding Eastern Slavonia, state radio reported on Tuesday.
It said the bank was close to finalising several programmes worth a total of $200-$250 million to back up the Croatian economy in the next few years.
The radio quoted central bank governor Marko Skreb as saying the World Bank considered opening a representative office in Zagreb early in 1997.
